sources.title: Duoduo learning agent runtime source
sources.content:
LearningAgentRuntime prepares a session from a deterministic plan.
The executor validates policy before navigation.
Checkpoints persist the original plan snapshot for recovery.

sources.title: JSON Schema validation notes
sources.content:
A JSON document can be syntactically valid while failing a JSON Schema.
Applications must validate both parsing and schema constraints.
